variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Connection string for the READ-ONLY role (create it with deploy/sql/001_readonly_role.sql). The sample database from `docker compose up -d db` listens on localhost:5544.

variables.name: ALLOWED_SCHEMAS
variables.description: Comma-separated schemas the AI may see and query.

variables.name: ALLOWED_TABLES
variables.description: Optional comma-separated table allow-list (`orders` or `public.orders`). Empty = all tables in ALLOWED_SCHEMAS.

variables.name: QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-query statement timeout in milliseconds.

variables.name: MAX_ROWS
variables.description: Maximum rows returned by one postgres_query call (results are truncated, and say so).

variables.name: DB_POOL_MAX_SIZE
variables.description: Connections in the pool, per server process. Keep (replicas x this) under the role's CONNECTION LIMIT (20).

variables.name: SHEETS_BACKEND
variables.description: `google` (real API via a service account) or `memory` (built-in demo spreadsheet, no Google account needed).

variables.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
variables.description: Path to the service-account key file, or the key JSON itself (e.g. injected from a secret store). Create one: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts → Keys → Add key → JSON. Enable the Sheets API: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/sheets.googleapis.com Then share your spreadsheet with the service account's email address.

variables.name: ALLOWED_SHEET_IDS
variables.description: Comma-separated spreadsheet IDs the AI may touch (the long ID in the sheet's URL). Empty = no sheets.

variables.name: SHEETS_MEMORY_FILE
variables.description: Only for SHEETS_BACKEND=memory: JSON file with demo spreadsheets (defaults to the bundled sample).

variables.name: SHEETS_TIMEOUT_S
variables.description: Timeout for one Google Sheets API request, in seconds.

variables.name: SHEETS_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Retries (exponential backoff + jitter) on 429 / 5xx / network errors.

variables.name: READ_ONLY
variables.description: true = write tools (sheets_append_rows, sheets_update_range) are not registered at all.

variables.name: TRANSPORT
variables.description: `stdio` (local AI clients) or `http` (remote, Streamable HTTP + OAuth bearer tokens).

variables.name: HTTP_HOST
variables.description: HTTP mode only. Use 0.0.0.0 inside a container.

variables.name: HTTP_PORT
variables.description: HTTP mode only: port to listen on.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: HTTP mode only: the public base URL clients use (OAuth resource identifier), e.g. https://mcp.example.com

variables.name: HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: HTTP mode only: extra Host header values to accept, comma-separated (DNS-rebinding protection).

variables.name: OAUTH_ISSUER
variables.section: OAuth 2.1 resource server (HTTP mode only — required there)
variables.description: Issuer of the access tokens (any OIDC provider: Entra ID, Auth0, Keycloak…). Local Keycloak test profile: http://localhost:8180/realms/mcp

variables.name: OAUTH_AUDIENCE
variables.section: OAuth 2.1 resource server (HTTP mode only — required there)
variables.description: Expected `aud` claim, e.g. the API's application ID URI (Entra ID) or `mcp-postgres-sheets` (Keycloak profile).

variables.name: OAUTH_JWKS_URL
variables.section: OAuth 2.1 resource server (HTTP mode only — required there)
variables.description: Optional JWKS URL override (defaults to the issuer's OIDC discovery document).

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN
variables.section: OAuth 2.1 resource server (HTTP mode only — required there)
variables.description: Tool calls allowed per caller (token subject) per minute.

variables.name: AUDIT_LOG_PATH
variables.description: File for the JSON-lines audit log. Empty = stderr (stdio mode) or stdout (http mode).

variables.name: REDACT_ARGS
variables.description: true = argument values are replaced by a hash + length in the audit log (identifiers like table names are kept).

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Server log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR). Logs never contain secrets or row data.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Server log format: auto (JSON lines in http mode, text in stdio mode), json or text.

variables.name: SENTRY_DSN
variables.description: Optional Sentry DSN for error tracking (install with the `sentry` extra). Empty = off. https://sentry.io → Project settings → Client keys (DSN)
